name: Social media content
short: Posts, Reels and carousels with a content calendar.
h1: Regular content, without you having to think about it.
lead: We plan and produce content for Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook. You approve, we deliver.

facts.who: SMEs and agencies with ongoing content needs
facts.what: Strategy, content calendar, posts, Reels, carousels

timeline: First monthly plan in 10 working days
problem: Social media gets left behind in day-to-day work. Posting is irregular, with no plan and no consistent look.
included: Copy in German, French or English

process.d: Content calendar for the next month.
You review; we schedule or hand over.

faq.a: The starter package covers eight posts per month, two of them short videos. The exact mix is set out in the quote.

faq.q: Do you also shoot on location?
faq.a: No. We work with your material, graphics and animation. Shoots are possible on request through partners.
Yes, if you give us permission. Otherwise we hand over the finished posts.
